headline: Chest-high prime angle but the wind's on it — small and soft.
today: Prime SSE angle and a bit of size to 2.3ft, but the wind's onshore/cross-on from dawn onward, so it never really cleans up. Longboard the morning if you're local, otherwise not worth the 2.5hr. Fading through the day.

daysToWatch.note: 2.8ft on a prime SSE angle with cross-off NNE/NE wind in the morning — clean and rideable. Short period, but the best clean-and-size combo of the run. Worth the drive.
Biggest day at nearly 3ft with NNW offshore at dawn going cross-off. Short-period S energy but glassy and overhead-ish — the standout morning of the week here.
